## Decomposition of the text-only attacker on test_id

- word-1/2gram LR macro-F1 = 0.527; an attacker that only knows the *evidence family* (event kind / assertion / noop) and picks the train-majority category = 0.540.
- So the share of attacker skill that is explained by evidence *family* (a semantic property: e.g. noop sentences are irrelevant by meaning, give/drop/pickup are mostly contradictory-or-resolving) is the part that cannot be removed without deleting that evidence type.

| assertion | 78 | 0.628 | {'resolving': 0, 'irrelevant': 36, 'contradictory': 42} |
| event:drop | 29 | 0.552 | {'resolving': 16, 'irrelevant': 0, 'contradictory': 13} |
| event:give | 23 | 0.652 | {'resolving': 7, 'irrelevant': 0, 'contradictory': 16} |
